Migrating Site Page to Incrementing Integers

November 2026

Introduction

I spent a bunch of time over the past week updating the way I do IDs for blog posts on the site and automating file creation for making a new entry.

After messing with it for a bit, I've decided to go a different route.

ID History

For years, I used my Grimoire to manage content on my site. The setup looked like this:

  • Each page of the Grimoire got its own file.

  • All the files were stored in a single folder.

  • Each file included an id (e.g. 3a/ut/av/na).

  • All the pages for the Grimoire were stored in text files. One file per page.

  • All the files

The strucutre of the Grimoire was as simple as could be: A single directory with one file per page.
